description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a command-line utility for the 'cuttlefish' project. It handles launching a specific binary ('/usr/bin/cvd') with fallback to a Python script if the binary is not available, and initializes logging in the main function.

methods.name: FallbackToPythonAcloud
methods.description: Attempts to run the 'acloud' Python script as a fallback if the 'cvd' binary is missing.

methods.name: TranslatorMain
methods.description: Main logic to check for the 'cvd' binary and execute it or fallback to the Python script.
